subject: Taxes
title: Tax Resistance Without Violence
description: One-minute skill: Tax Resistance Without Violence.

hook.text: Henry David Thoreau refused to pay his poll tax in 1846 to protest slavery.

buildup.text: Thoreau argued that paying taxes funding injustice makes you complicit.

discovery.text: Gandhi read Thoreau before the Salt March. Martin Luther King read Thoreau before Montgomery.

twist.text: Thoreau only spent one night in jail—someone paid his tax.

climax.text: Thoreau showed that refusing to pay taxes can be the most powerful form of political speech.

punchline.text: One night in jail, one essay. Thoreau's tax refusal changed the world.

quiz.question: Who wrote 'Civil Disobedience' after refusing to pay a poll tax?
